name: blog_select
label: Blog
help_text: Optional. Pull posts from this specific blog. Leave empty to use the blog this listing page belongs to (or the portal's default blog outside a blog). HubL has no "all blogs" lookup, so an empty value never means every blog in the portal.

name: exclude_post_id
label: Exclude post (ID)
help_text: Optional. Paste the ID of the post already shown as the Featured Article above this module (visible in that post's settings/URL in the HubSpot editor), so it isn't repeated here.

name: featured_tag
label: Featured tag
help_text: Optional. Marker tag used by the Feature Content module; it is hidden from the filters and cards. Must be the same tag selected in Feature Content.

name: exclude_featured
label: Exclude the Feature Content post
help_text: Turn on when a Feature Content module sits above this grid. Excludes (by post ID) the post it shows: the most recent post with the Featured tag, or, if none has it, the most recent post of the blog.

name: type_filter
label: Type filter
help_text: Optional second dropdown (used by the Resource Center). Off by default.

children.name: enabled
children.label: Show Types dropdown
children.help_text: When on, the tags listed below become Types: they move out of the Topics dropdown into a Types dropdown, and each card shows its Type before its Topic.

children.name: type_tags
children.label: Type tags
children.help_text: Pick the existing blog tags that describe a resource format (e.g. Guide, White paper). Every other tag stays a Topic. Use the editor-only Taxonomy check above the grid to review all tags and their post counts. Must match the Type tags in Feature Content.

children.name: placeholder
children.label: Types placeholder text
children.help_text: Shown as the first, unselected option in the Types dropdown.

name: posts_per_page
label: Posts per page
help_text: How many article cards to show per page of results.

name: columns
label: Columns (desktop)
help_text: Controls the card grid's column count on desktop (>= 768px). Always 1 column below that.

name: topic_placeholder
label: Topics placeholder text
help_text: Shown as the first, unselected option in the Topics dropdown. The dropdown's actual options are generated automatically from the selected blog's tags - there is nothing else to configure here.

name: cap_notice
label: Cap notice
help_text: Shown above the grid only when the blog has reached HubSpot's ~200-post limit for this module, so visitors know older posts are not included in the filters/search. Leave empty to hide.
default: Filters and search cover the 200 most recent articles.

name: card_heading_level
label: Card title heading level
help_text: Semantic level only - the card title always looks like an H5. Pick the level that follows the headings above this module on the page.

name: section_label
label: Section name (screen readers)
help_text: Accessible name of this section, e.g. Blog articles or Resources.

children.name: spacing_desktop
children.label: Desktop spacing
children.help_text: Top/bottom padding on desktop. Left/right are hidden - horizontal spacing comes from .content-wrapper.

children.name: spacing_mobile
children.label: Mobile spacing
children.help_text: Top/bottom padding at the theme's mobile breakpoint (max-width: 767px), independent of the desktop value above.
